knowledge_used.how_applied: SKILL-003 lists 'inductor-ripple output filters' as not applicable, so none of its capacitor equations (dQ/dV, DC-blocking C) are used for the inductor. What transfers is its procedure pattern (define the envelope, compute at every corner, select, hand placement to SKILL-002/SKILL-006) and the interface: the ripple computed here (dI = 6.5-8.7 App over corners/tolerance) is the input the output-capacitor agent needs for dQ = dI/(8 fs) and I_C,rms = dI/sqrt(12); KR-CAP-001/002 belong to that agent.

Applied by analogy to the inductor: P_loss,L must stay below P_max = (T_hot,max - T_A,max)/R_th,L. R_th,L comes from the Magnetics empirical surface-area model dT = (P_mW/A_cm2)^0.833 instead of a junction-case chain. With T_hot,max = 125 degC (added assumption), T_A = 50 degC and A_s = 161 cm2: P_max = 28.8 W versus 19.8 W worst-case overload loss (margin 1.45x).

Procedure steps 1-3 adapted to a magnetic component: losses over the envelope (section 7), thermal budget (section 8), placement so the inductor's own 15-20 W gets airflow. Step 3 'keep capacitors/magnetics out of exhaust' is a flagged AIPE recommendation without source evidence: it is surfaced as a placement request for human review (inductor in a parallel air path, not downstream of the heat sink).

25/27.5 A inductor terminals and the SW/VOUT pours are carried on wide 70 um pours repeated on two layers with via arrays; sized by IPC-2221 current/temperature-rise analysis (9.5 mm single-layer at 27.5 A/20 K -> specify >= 10 mm per layer on two paralleled layers, >= 30 stitching vias of 0.3 mm at ~1.2 A each). Rule confidence is 'low/single-reference', so the sizing rests on the IPC calculation, not on the rule alone.
Human-review evidence prepared: copper widths, via plating assumption (25 um), current and temperature-rise rationale listed in pcb_constraints.

The inductor lead-exit gap and the SW-side terminal radiate 50 kHz ripple and 400 V dV/dt; the feedback divider, current-sense Kelvin pair and control connector must not pass under or beside the inductor footprint (keep-out circle plus 10 mm).

The inductor is not mounted on the shared MOSFET heat sink. If the mechanical design later bolts the potting cup to the heat sink, the toroid's 3000 VAC wire-to-wire coating test is not a rated insulation system and a rated insulating interface would be required (human review in that case).

If a thermistor is added to the winding for supervision, its reading is a winding-surface temperature, not the hot spot inside the inner-diameter double layer; firmware must not treat it as a hot-spot limit without a validated offset.

Decision 9 (forced-air steady-state thermal budget, 40 degC ambient) gives the pattern reused for the inductor budget at the design-basis 50 degC; decision 10 (power pours repeated on several layers; magnetics placed where they do not lengthen electrical loops) informs the footprint. Instance values (sinks, pads, planar transformer cut-out) are not copied.
Applies to the output/DC-link capacitor agents; the inductor supplies the ripple current they need (dI worst 8.7 App -> I_C,rms = 2.5 A).
Hard-switched buck with 30 % ripple: the inductor is not sized for ZVS (that would need ripple > 200 % of Io); soft-switching range is an architecture decision, not an inductor requirement here.

Inductor terminals sit at VOUT (200 V) and SW (0-400 V) against PGND. The footprint reserves >= 4 mm creepage/clearance (IEC 60664-1, PD2, material group IIIa, 400 V working, basic) to be confirmed by the isolation agent.
Query hit is a gate-bias transformer record; it carries no reusable data for a 25 A output choke.

No AIPE knowledge item covers magnetics design. The fetched Magnetics Inc. 2024 catalog supplies the LI^2 selector method, the percent-permeability-vs-H fit (%u = 1/(a + b H^c)), the Steinmetz fit (P = a B^b f^c, mW/cm3, T, kHz), the DC magnetisation fit and the temperature-rise model dT = (P_mW/A_cm2)^0.833. Proposed for capture as a new skill (powder-core inductor design) with these coefficients as evidence.

selection.summary: No orderable standard inductor meets 220-300 uH at 25 A with a 29 A nominal / 31.5 A overload peak; a custom toroidal choke is specified: two stacked Magnetics 0058192A2 High Flux 60u cores (58 mm) wound with 34 turns of AWG 10 heavy-build magnet wire, L(25 A) = 272 uH (251-294 uH at AL +/-8 %), 29 % ripple at 400 V, 16-18 W loss, soft roll-off to 210 uH at 41 A, approx. 0.63 kg bare, potted in a UL94 V-0 cup and bolted to standoffs with leads in 3.2 mm plated holes.

winding.wire: AWG 10 (2.588 mm bare, 5.261 mm2) heavy-build polyester-imide/amide-imide, 200 degC class (NEMA MW 35-C or MW 82-C), OD approx. 2.72 mm; alternative: 2 x AWG 13 bifilar (same copper area, easier to wind)
winding.layout: single layer on the outer diameter, evenly spaced over ~340 deg, leaving a 10-15 mm gap at the lead exit; partial second layer on the inner diameter (ID circumference fits ~29 turns)

winding.insulation: 2 layers 0.1 mm polyester tape over the core stack before winding (core coating alone is not a rated insulation system); leads sleeved with 200 degC fibreglass sleeve to the PCB
winding.end_finish: varnish impregnation or full potting in cup (preferred, also fixes acoustic noise)

assumptions_added.name: Saturation-margin criterion for soft-saturating powder cores
assumptions_added.value: L(1.3 x I_pk,overload) >= 70 % of L(I_o) and B_dc + B_ac <= 0.8 x Bsat
assumptions_added.basis: Powder cores have no hard knee, so the seed's '30 % saturation margin' needs an inductance-based definition; 70 % keeps the ripple slope bounded for the current-limit trip and is stricter than typical 30 %-drop Isat definitions (Coilcraft, Wuerth).

assumptions_added.name: Winding hot-spot design limit
assumptions_added.value: 125 degC at 50 degC ambient
assumptions_added.basis: Wire (200 degC class), core coating (200 degC) and potting allow more, but 125 degC bounds adjacent-component heating, copper loss growth and PCB temperature; analogous to the 150 degC junction design limit below the 175 degC device maximum.

assumptions_added.name: Copper temperature for loss evaluation
assumptions_added.value: 100 degC
assumptions_added.basis: 50 degC ambient plus the computed 50 K rise; Rdc scales 1.31x from 20 degC.

assumptions_added.name: Toroid winding fill limit
assumptions_added.value: 40 % of window area (insulated wire area)
assumptions_added.basis: Magnetics catalogue design example and datasheet MLT/surface data are given at 40 % winding factor; machine winding needs a residual hole.

assumptions_added.name: MLT of a stacked core
assumptions_added.value: MLT_single(fill) + 2*(n-1)*HT
assumptions_added.basis: Geometry: each turn adds twice the extra stack height; +/-5 %.

assumptions_added.name: Surface area of the stacked wound coil
assumptions_added.value: 161 cm2 (2-stack), 203 cm2 (3-stack)
assumptions_added.basis: Datasheet 120 cm2 at 40 % WF for one core plus the lateral area of the added core height; +/-15 %.

assumptions_added.name: Core-loss waveform allowance
assumptions_added.value: 1.10 x Steinmetz (sinusoidal) value
assumptions_added.basis: Triangular flux with D = 0.45-0.56 under an iGSE-type correction for b ~ 2.2 is within ~10 % of sinusoidal loss at equal Bpk.

assumptions_added.name: No DC-bias correction of core loss
assumptions_added.value: Magnetics unbiased loss data used as-is; +20 % uncertainty noted
assumptions_added.basis: Catalogue states DC bias does not itself cause loss; literature shows High Flux loss can rise under bias.

assumptions_added.name: AC copper-loss model
assumptions_added.value: Dowell single-layer F_R = 5.9 with 1.02 harmonic factor; inner-diameter partial second layer ignored
assumptions_added.basis: AC loss is < 0.6 W, so even a 2x model error changes the total by < 4 %.

assumptions_added.name: Temperature-rise model
assumptions_added.value: dT = (P_mW/A_cm2)^0.833, natural convection, forced-air benefit not credited
assumptions_added.basis: Magnetics empirical method; its own caveat is that it is approximate (+/-30 %); the >= 2 m/s fan will lower the rise.

assumptions_added.name: Overload treated as thermal steady state
assumptions_added.value: 10 s overload evaluated at steady-state loss
assumptions_added.basis: Conservative: the 0.6 kg choke has a thermal time constant of many minutes.

assumptions_added.name: Wire data
assumptions_added.value: AWG 10: 2.588 mm, 5.261 mm2, 3.28 mohm/m at 20 degC, heavy-build OD 2.72 mm
assumptions_added.basis: Standard AWG tables / NEMA MW 1000 heavy build; not vendor-specific.

assumptions_added.name: Copper resistivity
assumptions_added.basis: IACS copper.

assumptions_added.name: N87 Steinmetz exponents (ferrite option only)
assumptions_added.value: alpha 1.36, beta 2.10 from TDK points 57 kW/m3 (25 kHz, 200 mT), 375 (100 kHz, 200 mT), 390 (300 kHz, 100 mT) at 100 degC
assumptions_added.basis: Derived from datasheet points obtained as search snippets; used only to reject the ferrite option.

assumptions_added.name: Gapped ferrite AL at 5 mm gap
assumptions_added.value: TDK K1/K2 fit at its validity limit, fringing beyond the fit not modelled
assumptions_added.basis: TDK E70/33/32 datasheet validity range 0.2 < s < 5 mm.

assumptions_added.name: PCB current capacity
assumptions_added.value: IPC-2221 external k = 0.048 / internal k = 0.024, b = 0.44, c = 0.725; via plating 25 um
assumptions_added.basis: Standard pooled-fabrication plating; IPC-2152 would allow narrower copper, so the result is conservative.

assumptions_added.name: Potting cup size and mass
assumptions_added.value: approx. OD 72 x 46 mm, +120-170 g epoxy
assumptions_added.basis: Generic toroid cups; exact part to be chosen by mechanical design.

assumptions_added.name: Relative core cost
assumptions_added.value: High Flux 4-6x Kool Mu, XFlux 1.2x (catalogue row); 2 cores estimated at tens of USD each
assumptions_added.basis: Magnetics catalogue relative-cost table; no quotation obtained.

assumptions_added.name: Airflow placement
assumptions_added.value: inductor in a parallel air path, not downstream of the heat sink
assumptions_added.basis: SKILL-006 step 3 recommendation (no source evidence) and the inductor's own 100-105 degC hot-spot estimate.

assumptions_added.name: Terminal creepage
assumptions_added.value: >= 4 mm to PGND / other nets
assumptions_added.basis: IEC 60664-1 basic insulation, PD2, material group IIIa, 400 V working; to be confirmed by the isolation agent.

pcb_constraints: Footprint L1: two PTH, finished hole 3.2 mm, pad 6.0 mm on every layer (70 um), no thermal relief; pitch 25.4 mm nominal (20-30 mm dressable); silkscreen and courtyard keep-out circle 75 mm diameter; component height 48 mm (potted) above the board (PE-PCB-006 evidence).

Four 4.3 mm NPTH mounting holes on a 60 x 60 mm pattern (adjust to the chosen cup) with 8 mm copper-free annulus for nylon hardware; if metal hardware tied to PGND is used, keep >= 4 mm creepage to SW/VOUT copper (KR-ISO-002, human review).

SW and VOUT pours at the terminals >= 10 mm wide on two paralleled 70 um layers, stitched with >= 30 vias (0.3 mm drill, 25 um plating, ~1.2 A each at 20 K rise) at each layer transition (KR-PCB-006, PE-PCB-006; IPC-2221: 9.5 mm single-layer at 27.5 A / 20 K).

SW-side terminal pour of minimum area and the SW lead < 30 mm from the half-bridge switch node; VOUT lead routed directly to the output capacitor bank and the current-sense element (PE-PCB-003 context, KR-PCB-005 analogy).

No feedback divider, current-sense Kelvin pair, gate-driver or control traces under or within 10 mm of the inductor keep-out; the lead-exit gap is the highest stray-field region (PE-PCB-005, adapted).
Mass (0.63-0.8 kg) carried by the cup/standoffs or clamp, never by the solder joints; standoff positions aligned with the mounting holes (V1 assumption pattern for the 285 g part reused).

Thermal: place in the fan's parallel air path with >= 10 mm to the heat sink; do not place downstream of the heat-sink exhaust (SKILL-006 step 3, flagged recommendation; human review); expected 15-20 W heat source at 100-105 degC surface.

Clearance to SELV control electronics: the inductor is a hazardous-voltage part (200-400 V); it must stay entirely within the power-domain area defined by the architecture/isolation agents; applies to both the single-board and the split-board partition.

Lead sleeving (200 degC fibreglass) from the winding to 3 mm above the pad; pads solder-filled from both sides (70 um copper, large thermal mass: specify soldering temperature profile / hand soldering note).
open_issues: No orderable standard part exists for 220-300 uH at 25-31 A; a custom winding (in-house or winding house) is required: procurement must order 2 (preferably 3 plus spares) 0058192A2 cores, AWG 10 heavy-build wire, cup and epoxy; lead time and winding-house quotation unknown.
2-stack (selected, 50-55 K estimated rise) versus 3-stack fallback (41-46 K, +230 g): decide after the first thermal test at 50 degC ambient and full load; recommend ordering cores for both.

Inductance tolerance: AL +/-8 % plus fit uncertainty gives L(25 A) = 235-294 uH and L(light load) up to 345 uH; the control-loop design must be stable for 230-350 uH; a measured L(I) curve on the first sample should replace the model.

Ripple hand-off: the output-capacitor agent should use dI_worst = 8.7 App (440 V, AL -8 %; 9.3 App including roll-off at the peak), I_C,rms = 2.5-2.7 A, not the 7.5 App seed; the current-sensing agent should size for 29.4 A nominal peak and 31.9 A overload peak; the protection agent can rely on L >= 190 uH up to 46 A.

Thermal model is empirical natural-convection (+/-30 %) and the forced-air benefit is not credited; verify with a thermocouple at the inner-diameter winding and on the core after 1 h at 440 V / 25 A / 50 degC; acceptance: hot spot <= 110 degC.

Core-loss data are unbiased sinusoidal Steinmetz fits; DC-bias and triangular-waveform effects may raise core loss by 10-30 % (5.9 W -> up to 7.7 W at 400 V); confirm by calorimetric or thermal measurement.
Acoustic noise: High Flux has higher magnetostriction than Kool Mu; 50 kHz is inaudible but load-transient and burst modulation could excite audible components; potting mitigates (recommended).
Mechanical: potting-cup part number, standoff height and the keep-out pattern must be fixed by the architecture/mechanical design; metal hardware would reopen the creepage review (KR-ISO-002).

The seed requirement 'saturation margin >= 30 % above the overload peak' was interpreted with an inductance-based criterion (L(41 A) >= 70 % of L(25 A)); the assumptions agent should ratify or replace this definition.

Efficiency: 16.4 W (0.33 %) at 400 V / 25 A is budgeted for the inductor; if the semiconductor agent needs more of the 100 W budget, the 3-stack option does not reduce loss (17.7 W) - only a larger core family or AWG 8 would, at higher mass.

Knowledge gap: no AIPE skill or rule covers magnetics; this record's methods and coefficients (Magnetics 2024 catalogue, datasheets 10/6/2021) should be captured as a new skill and component records (cores 0058192A2, 0077192A7, 0078192A7) for reuse.
The AIPE Magnetic Database has no schema in the repository yet (grep found none); the magnetic_record fields provided here are a proposal to be aligned with the database owner.

# Output inductor L1 - design and selection

## 1. Requirements and design basis

| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Topology / rails | synchronous buck, 400 V -> 200 V, common PGND | [USER] |
| Power / current | 5 kW, 25 A continuous; 27.5 A for 10 s | [USER]/[SEED] |
| Switching frequency | 50 kHz | [USER] |
| Input range | 360-440 V -> D = 0.556 / 0.500 / 0.455 | [SEED] |
| Ripple target | 30 % of Io at 400 V = 7.5 App -> L_ideal = Vout(1-D)/(dI fs) = 200 x 0.5 / (7.5 x 50e3) = 267 uH; acceptable 220-300 uH at 25 A | [SEED] |
| Peaks | 28.75 A nominal, ~31.3 A overload; saturation margin >= 30 % above the overload peak at operating temperature | [SEED] |
| Environment | 50 degC ambient, forced air >= 2 m/s, efficiency >= 98 % | [SEED] |

All results below are evaluated at Vin = 360 / 400 / 440 V, Iout = 25 and 27.5 A, copper at 100 degC and AL = -8 / 0 / +8 %.

## 2. Knowledge applied

SKILL-003 excludes inductor-ripple output filters, so none of its capacitor equations are used; what transfers is its envelope-first procedure and the hand-off: the ripple derived in section 6 feeds the output-capacitor agent's dQ = dI/(8 fs) and I_C,rms = dI/sqrt(12) (KR-CAP-001/002 belong there). KR-TH-001 is applied by analogy, P_loss,L <= (T_hot,max - T_A)/R_th,L, with R_th,L from the Magnetics surface-area model. SKILL-006 steps 1-3 are adapted; its step 3 (magnetics out of the heat-sink exhaust) is a flagged recommendation without source evidence and is surfaced for human review. KR-PCB-006 / PE-PCB-006 size the 25 A copper; PE-PCB-005 is adapted to the lead-exit gap. KR-TH-002 does not apply unless the cup is bolted to the shared sink. REF-TI-TIDA-010054 decision 9 gives the forced-air budget pattern (40 -> 50 degC), instance values not copied. No AIPE record covers magnetics; the fetched Magnetics 2024 catalogue methods (LI^2 selector, %u = 1/(a + b H^c), P = a B^b f^c, dT = (P/A)^0.833) are used and proposed as a new skill.

## 3. Standard-part search - result: nothing suitable

| Family (verification) | Closest member | Why it fails |
|---|---|---|
| Coilcraft AGP4233 (datasheet 917-1, 07/28/26) | AGP4233-224ME, 220 uH, DCR 10.9 mohm, 135 g | Isat 6.4 / 7.2 / 7.6 A (10/20/30 % drop) vs 29 A peak; ferrite hard saturation |
| Hammond 195 (snippet) | 195C30, 1 mH at 30 A, 9 mohm | 3.7x the inductance, laminated steel, multi-kg, 50/60 Hz part |
| Vishay IHXL-1500VZ-3A (datasheet 30-Jun-2025) | 0.68-10 uH | max 10 uH |
| Vishay IHDM-1008BC (product page) | tens of uH class, 180 degC | no 220-300 uH member evidenced; no IHDM-1500 series exists |
| Wuerth WE-HCF/HCFT/TPC (product page) | 10 uH, Isat 32.6 A; 33 uH, Isat 10.5 A | Isat collapses above tens of uH |
| Bourns 2300/2200 (snippet) | 2316-RC 220 uH, 5.8 A | current |
| Bel/Signal HCTI (brochure 2023) | HCTI-220-5.8, 220 uH, 5.8 A | series max 20 A at 10 uH |
| Pulse PE-515xx (snippet) | 400 uH, 3.6 A | series max 17 A |
| Triad C-60U (snippet); Standex | 5 mH, 22.5 A chassis choke | wrong L and I; Standex no hit |
| Schaffner RD, TDK B82615/B82726 (snippets) | common-mode / harmonic chokes | not differential energy-storage parts |
| Magnetics Inc., Micrometals | cores only | no assembled standard chokes |

A 267 uH / 31 A choke stores 0.5 L I^2 = 0.22 J at the margin current (LI^2 = 262 mH A^2 at the overload peak), which is beyond every catalogue power inductor found; a custom magnetic is required.

## 4. Custom design method (Magnetics catalogue, fetched)

1. H[Oe] = 0.4 pi N I / le[cm]; %u = 1/(0.01 + b H^c); L(I) = n AL N^2 %u/100 (High Flux 60u toroids: b = 6.413e-8, c = 2.291; anchors 80 % min at 90 Oe, 50 % min at 170 Oe from the datasheet).
2. dI = Vout(1-D)/(L(Io) fs); dB = Vout(1-D)/(N n Ae fs) (volt-second, independent of L); Bpk = dB/2.
3. Pv[mW/cm3] = a Bpk^b f^c with B in T, f in kHz (High Flux 60u: 246.54, 2.218, 1.311); Pcore = Pv Ve x 1.10 waveform allowance.
4. Rdc = rho(100 degC) N MLT / Aw; Pdc = I^2 Rdc; skin depth delta = sqrt(rho/(pi f mu0)) = 0.339 mm at 100 degC; Dowell single-layer F_R; Pac = 1.02 F_R Rdc dI^2/12.
5. dT = (P[mW]/A_s[cm2])^0.833 (natural convection); P_max = A_s (125 - 50)^(1/0.833).
6. Saturation (added criterion): L(1.3 x I_pk,ovl) >= 0.70 L(Io) and B_dc + B_ac <= 0.8 Bsat.

## 5. Options compared

| Option | L(25 A) uH | L(31.3 A) | L(41 A) [% of L25] | dI 400/440 V | Loss worst nominal | dT est. | Mass | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coilcraft AGP4233-224ME | saturated | - | - | - | - | - | 135 g | fails Isat |
| 2 x 77192A7 Kool Mu 60u, 50 T AWG12 | 258 | 195 | 134 [52 %] | 7.8 / 8.5 | 27.1 W (Cu 24.4) | 71 K | 0.50 kg | fails margin, hot |
| 2 x 58192A2 High Flux 60u, 34 T AWG10 | 272 | 248 | 210 [77 %] | 7.3 / 8.0 | 17.7 W (Cu 10.5, Fe 7.2) | 50 K | 0.63 kg | SELECTED |
| 3 x 58192A2 High Flux 60u, 28 T AWG10 | 293 | 274 | 243 [83 %] | 6.8 / 7.5 | 17.7 W | 41 K | 0.84 kg | fallback |
| 2 x 78192A7 XFlux 60u, 36 T AWG11 | 300 | 266 | 212 [71 %] | 6.7 / 7.3 | 29.4 W (Fe 15.7) | 76 K | 0.56 kg | fails (core loss) |
| 1 x 77102A7 Kool Mu 26u, 90 T AWG10 | 299 | 267 | 225 [75 %] | 6.7 / 7.3 | 28.5 W (Cu 26) | 38 K | 0.91 kg, OD 112 | rejected |
| 2 x E70/33/32 N87, s = 5 mm, 23 T Litz 735x38 | 268 | 268 | hard knee: B(41 A) 0.38 T vs 0.39 T Bsat(100 degC) | 7.3 / 8.1 | 14.4 W | n/a | 1.3 kg | fails margin, mass |

Kool Mu 60u rolls off to 37 % at the required 126 Oe, costing 50 turns and 24 W of copper; XFlux matches High Flux on bias but has 2.3x its core loss at 64 mT / 50 kHz; the gapped ferrite needs a 5 mm centre-leg gap (fit validity limit, heavy fringing), weighs 1.3 kg, its Litz does not fit the bobbin (67 % of AN) and it saturates hard at the margin current. The two-stack High Flux toroid is the balanced choice; the three-stack is 10 K cooler for +230 g and is the thermal fallback.

## 6. Selected design - specification

- Core: 2 x Magnetics 0058192A2, High Flux 60u toroid, coated OD 58.04 max / ID 25.58 min / HT 16.13 max mm, AL 138 nH +/-8 % each (276 nH stacked), Ae 229 mm2 (458 stacked), le 125 mm, Ve 28.6 cm3 (57.2 stacked), Wa 514 mm2, 218 g each, Bsat 1.5 T, Curie 500 degC, coating 3000 VAC wire-to-wire, 200 degC (datasheet rev 10/6/2021, fetched).
- Winding: 34 turns AWG 10 heavy-build 200 degC magnet wire (2.588 mm bare, 5.26 mm2, OD ~2.72 mm; alternative 2 x AWG 13 bifilar), single layer on the OD with a partial second layer at the ID, 10-15 mm lead gap, fill 38 % of Wa, MLT ~110 mm, 3.73 m of wire, 176 g copper, J = 4.75 A/mm2 at 25 A. Two layers of 0.1 mm polyester tape under the winding; sleeved leads; potted.
- Inductance (nominal AL): L0 = 319 uH; 308 uH at 12.5 A; 289 at 20 A; 272 at 25 A (251-294 at AL +/-8 %; 235 uH with -8 % AL and the datasheet-minimum bias curve); 263 at 27.5 A; 258 at the 28.7 A nominal peak; 248 at the 31.5 A overload peak; 210 at 41 A; 70 % of L(25 A) is reached at 46 A and 50 % of L0 at 55 A. High Flux permeability shifts ~4.5 % over -60 to 200 degC, so temperature changes L by < 3 %.

### Ripple, flux and losses at the corners (25 A unless noted)

| Vin | D | dI App (AL -8 %) | Ipk A | dB / Bpk mT | Pv mW/cm3 | Pcore W | Pcu dc + ac W | Ptot W (27.5 A) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 360 V | 0.556 | 6.5 (7.1) | 28.3 | 114 / 57 | 73 | 4.6 | 10.0 + 0.34 | 14.9 (17.0) |
| 400 V | 0.500 | 7.3 (8.0) = 29 % | 28.7 | 128 / 64 | 94 | 5.9 | 10.0 + 0.43 | 16.4 (18.5) |
| 440 V | 0.455 | 8.0 (8.7; 9.3 with roll-off at the peak) | 29.0 (29.4) | 140 / 70 | 114 | 7.2 | 10.0 + 0.51 | 17.7 (19.8) |

Rdc = 12.2 mohm at 20 degC, 16.0 mohm at 100 degC. With d/delta = 7.6 the single-layer Dowell factor is 5.9, yet the AC copper loss is < 0.6 W because the AC rms current is only dI/sqrt(12) = 2.3 A; harmonics of the triangular current add ~3 % (amplitudes fall as 1/n^2, resistance rises as sqrt(n)). Litz wire is therefore not justified for the toroid (it would be for the gapped ferrite because of fringing). B_dc from the catalogue magnetisation fit is 0.49 T at 25 A, 0.60 T at 31.3 A and 0.73 T at 41 A; with Bpk,ac = 0.07 T the core reaches 0.80 T = 53 % of Bsat, so true saturation is far away and the roll-off is the only effect. The inductor consumes 16.4 W = 0.33 % of Po at 400 V / 25 A against the 100 W total allowed by the 98 % target.

### Thermal (KR-TH-001 analogy)

Surface area of the wound two-core stack ~161 cm2 (datasheet 120 cm2 for one core at 40 % WF plus the lateral area of the second core). dT = (17 700 / 161)^0.833 = 50 K at the 440 V nominal worst case and 55 K during the 10 s overload (treated as steady state), i.e. a hot spot of 100-105 degC at 50 degC ambient under natural convection; the >= 2 m/s fan will lower this but is not credited. With a 125 degC hot-spot design limit the allowed loss is P_max = 161 x 75^1.2 mW = 28.8 W, 1.45x the 19.8 W overload loss. The model is empirical (+/-30 %) and must be confirmed by measurement.

### Saturation margin

At 1.3 x 31.5 A = 41 A the inductance is 210 uH = 77 % of L(25 A) (criterion >= 70 %) and the flux 0.80 T <= 1.2 T: pass. The protection agent may rely on L >= 190 uH up to 46 A; there is no hard knee.

## 7. Mechanical, mounting and PCB footprint

Wound size ~65 mm OD (69 max with tape) x 40-43 mm, residual hole >= 14 mm; mass 632 g bare, 750-800 g potted. Mount horizontally (axis vertical) in a UL94 V-0 toroid potting cup (~72 x 46 mm) with thermally conductive epoxy, fixed by 4 x M4 screws to standoffs or chassis so the solder joints carry no mass (the rule V1 applied to its 285 g part); alternative: nylon M6 centre bolt, clamp plate and silicone pad. The AWG 10 leads enter 3.2 mm finished plated holes with 6.0 mm pads on all 70 um layers, pitch 25.4 mm nominal (20-30 mm dressable). Copper per KR-PCB-006 / PE-PCB-006: IPC-2221 gives 1034 mil2 = 9.5 mm single-layer width for 27.5 A at 20 K, so each terminal uses >= 10 mm wide pours on two paralleled layers with >= 30 stitching vias (0.3 mm, 25 um plating, ~1.2 A each). Keep-out 75 mm x 48 mm plus 10 mm to the heat sink; feedback, Kelvin sense pairs and control traces stay outside it (PE-PCB-005). Pads keep >= 4 mm creepage to PGND and other nets (isolation agent, KR-ISO-002). The SW-side pour is small and within 30 mm of the half-bridge; the VOUT lead goes directly to the output capacitors and the current-sense element. Place in the fan's parallel air path, not downstream of the heat-sink exhaust (SKILL-006 step 3, flagged). The part is hazardous-voltage and stays in the power domain in either board partition.

## 8. Interfaces to other agents

- Output capacitor: dI_worst = 8.7 App (440 V, AL -8 %; 9.3 with roll-off), I_C,rms = 2.5-2.7 A; 7.3 App nominal at 400 V.
- Current sensing / protection: peaks 29.0 A nominal (29.4 worst), 31.5 A overload (31.9 worst); L >= 190 uH to 46 A, soft roll-off only.
- Control: L = 345 -> 235 uH from no load to 25 A over tolerance; design for 230-350 uH.
- Thermal / architecture: 15-20 W source at 100-105 degC needing its own airflow.

## 9. Status

Analytically checked: duty and ripple at all corners; L(I) from datasheet AL and catalogue permeability fit including AL tolerance and the datasheet-minimum curve; volt-second flux swing; Steinmetz core loss; DC and AC copper loss; fill factor, MLT, wire length and mass; empirical temperature rise and the KR-TH-001-type loss limit; saturation/roll-off margin; IPC-2221 copper and via sizing; the three rejected custom options and the ferrite alternative.

Unverified: forced-air thermal benefit and the +/-30 % accuracy of the surface-area model; core-loss increase under DC bias and triangular excitation (+10-30 %); the inner-diameter proximity loss (small); Hammond, Bourns, Bel, Pulse, Triad, Schaffner, TDK-EPCOS rejections rest on search snippets (their inductance/current classes are far from the target, so the conclusion is robust); the Vishay IHDM-1008BC datasheet was not fetched; N87 material points are search snippets; potting-cup dimensions and mass; relative core cost; measured L(I), Rdc and temperature on a sample.

Human review: the inductance-based interpretation of the 30 % saturation margin (assumptions agent); placement out of the heat-sink exhaust and in a parallel air path (SKILL-006 step 3 has no source evidence); terminal creepage and mounting hardware (KR-ISO-002); 2-stack versus 3-stack after the first thermal test; acoustic-noise acceptance (High Flux magnetostriction); custom-winding procurement; adoption of the Magnetics methods as a new AIPE skill and alignment of the proposed magnetic_record with the AIPE Magnetic Database schema.
